name: Alert
description: You are impossible to surprise. You can take reactions on turns you aren't surprised.

name: Actor
description: You are adept at acting and deceiving. You have advantage on Performance and Deception checks.

name: Craftsman
description: You are skilled at crafting. You have proficiency with one tool of your choice.

name: Athlete
description: You are trained in athletics. Climbing and jumping are easier for you.

name: Charger
description: You can make a powerful charge attack. When you use Dash, you can make a melee attack as a bonus action.

name: Crossbow Expert
description: You ignore the loading property of crossbows and can fire in melee without disadvantage.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: When wielding a finesse weapon and a creature attacks you, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency to AC.

name: Dual Wielder
description: You can use two-weapon fighting more effectively. You can draw two weapons in one action.

name: Dungeon Delver
description: You are adept at navigating dungeons. You have advantage on Perception and Investigation checks for traps.

name: Durable
description: You are tough and resilient. When you heal, you heal the maximum possible.

name: Elemental Adept
description: You can choose one type of damage: fire, cold, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast of that type ignore resistance.

name: Grappler
description: You are skilled at grappling. You can use your bonus action to attempt to pin a creature.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: You can make powerful attacks with heavy weapons. When you score a critical hit, you can make another attack.

name: Healer
description: You are skilled at healing. You can stabilize creatures and your healing kits are more effective.

name: Heavy Armor Master
description: You are trained in heavy armor. While wearing heavy armor, you have damage reduction against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: You can inspire others with a speech. Allies within 30ft gain temporary HP.

name: Keen Mind
description: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and details perfectly.

name: Lightly Armored
description: You are trained in light armor. You gain proficiency with light armor.

name: Lucky
description: Fate favors you. You can reroll a d20, but must use the new result.

name: Mage Slayer
description: You are trained to fight spellcasters. You can interrupt concentration and have advantage on saves against spells.

name: Martial Adept
description: You have training in martial techniques. You learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master archetype.

name: Medium Armor Master
description: You are trained in medium armor. You have no disadvantage on Stealth while wearing medium armor.

name: Mobile
description: You are swift and agile. Difficult terrain doesn't slow your movement and you don't provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Moderately Armored
description: You are trained in medium armor and shields. You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Observant
description: You are keen-eyed and perceptive. You can read lips and notice hidden creatures more easily.

name: Polearm Master
description: You can use polearms more effectively. You can make a bonus action attack with the butt of the weapon.

name: Resilient
description: You have training in one ability saving throw of your choice.

name: Ritual Caster
description: You can cast spells as rituals if you have them prepared. You can cast two level 1 spells as rituals.

name: Savage Attacker
description: You can make particularly vicious attacks. You can reroll damage dice.

name: Sentinel
description: You are a master of defending others. You can stop enemies from moving past you.

name: Sharpshooter
description: You are a master of ranged weapons. Your long-range attacks are deadly.

name: Shield Master
description: You can use your shield to protect yourself and others. You can shove with your shield.

name: Skilled
description: You can choose three skills or tools to gain proficiency in.

name: Slasher
description: You are trained to cut with blades. Slashing weapon critical hits reduce speed.

name: Spell Sniper
description: You are trained in ranged spell attacks. You can cast spells at long range without disadvantage.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: You are trained in fighting with improvised weapons and unarmed strikes.

name: Terrain Expert
description: You are familiar with one type of terrain. You are never slowed in that terrain.

name: Weapon Master
description: You master a variety of weapons. You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.

name: Explorer
description: You are skilled at navigating the wild. You are never slowed by difficult terrain.

name: Lore Keeper
description: You have studied ancient lore. You can identify magic items and have advantage on History checks.
